_comment: DJ toolkit configuration. Copy to ~/.dj-toolkit/config.json (or set DJTK_CONFIG) and fill in — or better, run the dj-onboard skill which builds this interactively from YOUR library. Fields marked (onboard) are discovered/asked during onboarding.
_database_dir: Folder containing rekordbox's master.db (e.g. 'D:/PIONEER/Master'). null = pyrekordbox auto-detect from the default install location.
_music_roots: Folders to search when a track's stored path is missing (audio analysis needs the real files). e.g. ['D:/Library', 'C:/Users/me/Dropbox/rekordbox']
_genres: Your main performing genre families: substring matches against the rekordbox Genre field + a BPM window. 'primary' drives cue mining, character calibration and vocal analysis defaults.
_tags: (onboard) MyTag IDs from YOUR library (they differ per database — list them with the get_my_tags MCP tool). 'vocal' marks vocal-forward tracks (ground truth for vocal spacing). 'ignore' = tags whose tracks should never enter generated sets.
_star_to_energy: (onboard) How star ratings map to energy tags for assign_energy_tags.py. Overlaps are allowed (a rating can grant two tags).
_character_tags: (onboard) MyTag NAMES you use that mean melodic/light vs heavy/dark. calibrate.py fits the audio character model against these. Leave empty to skip character calibration.
_cue_system: (onboard) Written by mine_cue_system.py after analyzing your existing cues. Shape: {'anchor_slot': 'C', 'anchor_meaning': 'the drop', 'ladders': {'primary': {'D': -4, 'B': -32, ...offsets in beats before the anchor...}, 'secondary': {...}}}. null = cue tools run in manual-anchor mode only.
_vocal_names: Extends the shipped vocalist/producer name lists in find_vocal_credits.py: names in credits that indicate a vocal track (extra_vocalists) or that make a 'feat.' a producer collab, not a vocal (producers).
_rating_colors: Optional: encode star rating as track color, e.g. {'5': 'Red', '4': 'Orange', '3': 'Yellow', '2': 'Purple', '1': 'Blue'}. Used by sync_rating_colors.py. null = feature off.
_preferences: Set-building guardrails learned from your feedback: artists never to auto-place, artists that read heavier than their audio suggests, vocal density/spacing caps.
